name: Sakuranbo Kaigan
source:
Your grandmother has got a house at the beach but she doesn't need it, so you can have it. You have the idea that you could use it during summer vacation as a restaurant. Of course you will meet many girls (and a boy) who would love to work for you in the restaurant. 

[Edited from [url=https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/pc/578080-sakuranbo-kaigan/reviews/18157]Exaxxion's review[/url]]
translation:
你的祖母在海邊有一棟已經不需要的房子，於是把它交給了你。你靈機一動，決定暑假在那裡開餐廳。當然，你會遇見許多願意在餐廳為你工作的姑娘（還有一名男生）。

[改寫自[url=https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/pc/578080-sakuranbo-kaigan/reviews/18157]Exaxxion的評論[/url]]
